_comment: Expiring, auditable allow-list for dependency advisories that have NO safe upgrade path yet. scripts/ci/check-dependency-advisories.mjs HARD-FAILS CI on ANY advisory not listed here (or listed but expired). This is the ONLY bypass — the same model as arch-gate.waivers.json. Shrink this list; never let an entry lapse silently. Each entry needs: ghsa, package, reason (incl. the in-app mitigation), added, expires, owner.

waivers.reason: Quill 2.0.3 XSS via the HTML-export feature has NO upstream patch (react-quill-new -> quill@2.0.3). Mitigated in-app, defense-in-depth: ALL rich-text is passed through the DOMPurify strict allow-list (src/lib/security.ts#sanitizeHtml) on render AND re-sanitized by the sanitize_user_html DB trigger on write, so Quill's exported HTML is never rendered untrusted. Remove this waiver when react-quill-new ships a patched quill.

braces@3.0.3 is a transitive BUILD-TIME dependency (tailwindcss-animate -> Tailwind/PostCSS content globbing via micromatch); it runs only during `npm run build`, never in the shipped static bundle nor the Supabase Deno edge runtime. braces has NO upstream patch yet — 3.0.3 is the latest 3.x and is itself the vulnerable version; the only fix npm offers is a major micromatch/tailwind upgrade. The deeply-nested-pattern stack-exhaustion DoS is unreachable in production (it never parses user-controlled glob patterns). Remove when the Tailwind chain ships a patched braces.
